description: §7.6 rule (b) (S483 q8-fu2) — initializers inside `if=` content that cannot trap stay legal and run: a `%` with a `number` dividend by an `int` divisor (`7.0 % n0` — a `number`, NaN) and a `replaceAll` on literals that fit (`"abc".replaceAll("b", "xyz")`).
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-q8-division, governing clause: "inside a construct refuse only what can actually trap" — `%` lowers to the host `%`, and a `number` operand makes the result a `number` (NaN by 0); the trap owed by gap g-bootstrap-int-overflow-and-mod-zero-untrapped-s469 is on an `int` result only (#2133 review item 3; prov=pa-ruled:S483-mixed-mod-no-trap). A `replaceAll` whose receiver and replacement are literals with a provably fitting result cannot trap (#2133 review MED-1).
